ability.name: P0 — Current Privilege State Check
ability.description: Performs local context check by querying current token groups and privileges without modifying the system state.

stages.stage_name: Check Current Privileges and Integrity Level
stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { whoami /all; whoami /groups } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\out.txt

rationale: Following the evaluator feedback and constraints, we avoid using $error.Clear() in double-quoted strings. This check runs both mandatory commands 'whoami /all' and 'whoami /groups' sequentially to fully resolve the integrity level and privilege state while matching the exact detailed executor-aware Tee-Object piping requirement.
